resources.string: Choose the server you want to use. Pebrel installs a small encrypted relay over SSH; no Docker, Node.js or domain name is required.

Uninstall
Stops the relay and removes only Pebrel-managed service files. Connected devices will disconnect. Credentials are kept for reinstallation unless you choose to remove them.
Also remove pairing configuration and keys

Supports Linux x64/ARM64 with systemd 247+ or Alpine OpenRC. Root SSH access is required for management; the relay runs without root privileges. Both devices must reach the relay port (443 by default); Pebrel does not change your firewall.

On your computer, open Settings → Phone connection → Relay, select this SSH server and choose Use this relay server. Then generate a QR code for your phone. You can also save a private configuration file below.
This file contains server access credentials. Transfer it privately to your computer; do not publish it.
